dataset: J/70 World Championship 2026, Cascais — race analysis from Vakaros Atlas telemetry
licence_note: Telemetry belongs to the boats that recorded it. Scored results and race analysis are the event organisers'. Published here for the teams involved.

conventions.time: UTC throughout, ISO 8601 with a trailing Z
conventions.speed: knots unless a field says otherwise
conventions.wind_direction: the direction the wind is coming FROM
conventions.null: means no data. It never means zero, and no file substitutes one for the other
conventions.boat_names: as written on the log file, with a small alias map applied; the same string is used as the join key across every file

files.name: meta
files.about: Venue, calibrated model bias, tacking angle, event dates and telemetry coverage.

files.name: fleet
files.about: One row per decoded .vkx log: session extent, fix count, distance and speed splits.

fields.file: Log file, named for the boat
fields.avg: Mean SOG over the whole session, knots
fields.upAvg: Mean SOG below 8 kn (treated as upwind), knots
fields.dnAvg: Mean SOG at or above 8 kn (treated as downwind), knots

files.name: legs
files.about: Wind-referenced VMG per boat per leg, plus the correlations between each variable and first-beat VMG across the tracked fleet.

fields.wind: Wind on this leg as measured by the event, degrees true
fields.vmg: Mean wind-referenced VMG, knots — the component of boat speed along the wind axis
fields.twa: Mean true wind angle, degrees off the wind
fields.eff: VMG divided by SOG (definitional, not an independent measure)
fields.svmg: Mean VMG over the fixes outside a manoeuvre, knots — boat speed with turning removed, so a boat that manoeuvres more is not measured as slower for it
fields.ssog: Mean SOG over the same fixes, knots
fields.stwa: Mean true wind angle over the same fixes, degrees
fields.keep: Share of the leg's fixes left after removing the manoeuvre windows (-10 s to +15 s around a tack, -10 s to +20 s around a gybe)
fields.extra: Distance sailed beyond the straight line, metres
fields.tloss_m: Mean ground lost per tack, metres — what the boat would have made good in the manoeuvre window at its settled VMG, minus what it did make good
fields.tloss_s: The same per tack, as seconds of sailing at that VMG to win it back
fields.gloss_m: Mean ground lost per gybe, metres
fields.loss_m: Ground lost to every manoeuvre on the leg, metres
fields.loss_s: The same, seconds. Negative means the boat made better VMG through its manoeuvres than over the rest of the leg
fields.tdip: Mean speed dip through a tack, knots — a diagnostic, not the cost
fields.gdip: Mean speed dip through a gybe, knots

files.name: races
files.about: Mark timings, speed splits and start-line position per boat per race, with the race header (gun, line length and bearing, measured wind) alongside.

fields.ex: Extra distance sailed over the race, metres
fields.dl: Distance to the start line at the gun, metres (negative = over)
fields.al: Position along the line, 0 = pin, 1 = committee boat

files.name: segments
files.about: Maximum speed held over rolling windows, 9 Sep. Transcribed from the event's published table; the hold ratio and ranks are derived here.

fields.hold: The 60 s figure divided by the peak — how much of the headline number survives a minute

files.name: kpi
files.about: Top five and the client boat joined across scored results, the segment table and VMG from the logs. Nulls mean no data, never zero.

fields.pts: Total points — no discard has been applied at four races
fields.gain: Places won between the first windward mark and the finish, summed over races
fields.peak: Instantaneous peak speed on 9 Sep, knots
fields.s60: Best speed held 60 s on 9 Sep, knots
fields.vmg: Mean upwind VMG from this boat's own log, knots
fields.twa: Mean upwind true wind angle, degrees
fields.svmg: The same VMG with every tack cut out of the average, knots

files.name: official
files.about: Scored standings, not derived from telemetry.

fields.pts: Net points — the total with the worst race discarded
fields.codes: Scoring code per race where one applies (DNC, DNF, DSQ, PRP), else null
fields.gain: Places won after the first windward mark, races 1-4 only

files.name: wind
files.about: Three-model consensus at the race area, hourly 11:00-18:00 UTC, refreshed every three hours. Raw and bias-corrected direction side by side.

fields.raw: Model consensus wind direction, degrees true
fields.cor: Direction after the +16.1 deg fleet-measured bias, degrees true; null when not trusted
fields.sp: Spread between the three models, degrees
fields.trust: False below 8 kn or above 30 deg of spread — the bias is not applied there

files.name: bias
files.about: GRIB forecast against wind measured on the water, per race. This is where the +16.1 deg correction comes from, and it is not a constant.

fields.forecast: GRIB direction at the first beat, degrees true
fields.measured: Direction measured on the water, degrees true
fields.old_observed: An earlier, superseded observation, kept for audit
fields.old_bias: The error that earlier observation produced

files.name: startline
files.about: Line geometry per race, with the event's published advantage beside the one our own formula produces from the geometry alone.

fields.setting: Direction the committee set the line to, degrees true
fields.bias_m: Advantage to the favoured end, metres, as the event published it
fields.calc_m: The same advantage from our own geometry: line_m x sin(bias_deg)

files.name: wind_by_leg
files.about: Wind bearing measured on each leg of each race by the event.

files.name: daycompare
files.about: Boats with a log on both 8 and 9 Sep — same hulls, same crews, different breeze.

files.name: coach
files.about: Coaching notes, transcribed. Not measured, and labelled as such.

files.name: brief
files.about: The analysis requirements, with what is validated and what is open.

files.name: tracks
files.about: Position, SOG, COG and leg index at 2 s for every boat in races 1 and 2, one columnar file per boat per race, plus estimated mark positions. This is what a course plan view or a polar scatter is drawn from.
